qualification: Generated guest ACPI and private IOAPIC integration
inputs: Same pinned OVMF/kernel and Intel gate invocation as ovmf-boot-payload.json; 256MiB private RAM, no initrd or command line
changes: Immutable fw_cfg tables, RSDP and 19-command relocation/checksum stream
FACS, empty DSDT, FADT, MADT, CPU SSDT, RSDT and XSDT describe exactly one provisioned CPU and private controllers
24-input IOAPIC fixed/lowest-priority delivery to sole LAPIC, masks, edge/level pending state, Remote IRR and matching-vector EOI
ARAT only for admitted invariant-TSC clock profile
Validated CMOS century writes outside SET preserve weekday and subsecond phase
Accept only absent-PIT shutdown writes and stateless byte I/O-delay writes; periodic PIT requests and timer reads remain rejected

FAIL exit2 at Linux PIT shutdown, not periodic setup
intermediate_runs.analysis: Pinned decompressed Linux instruction ffffffff8239a262 is OUT43,AL preceded by MOV EAX,30 and followed by two zero writes to40 and another30 write to43. Matches clockevent_i8253_disable; relocation26e00000.

intermediate_runs.result: FAIL exit2 at Linux native_io_delay OUTed,AL
intermediate_runs.analysis: Pinned kernel instruction ffffffff813b1416 is OUTed,AL in native_io_delay; relocation9a00000.

host_checks: Exact fw_cfg directory and source bytes; loader interpreted at three bases with bounded relocations, table/root pointers and checksums; IOAPIC edge/level/mask/EOI/vector-reprogramming and independent LAPIC state; CPU ARAT gating; RTC century/phase/invalid-date rejection

sanitizers.command: make test-x86-acpi-loader-host test-x86-config-host test-x86-rtc-host test-x86-ioapic-host test-x86-apic-host test-x86-cpu-host CC='cc -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer'

limitations: No Linux userspace or successful Intel gate
No dedicated guest IOAPIC/LAPIC interrupt-handler proof
No canonical x86 device backend connected to IOAPIC inputs
No runtime SMP, hotplug, sleep, PCI endpoints, MSI or enabled SCI source
No firmware-installed-table dump independently verifying every guest-visible table
Unsupported MSRs still terminate this qualification profile rather than inject guest #GP
No exit limit or gate success criterion was relaxed
